title: Galois partitions and weakly constructible module classes
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme]. A Galois partition $\mathcal P$ consists of a finite locally closed stratification [def-constructible-stratification] with nonempty connected [def-weil-connected-scheme] reduced [def-pc-reduced-scheme] strata $S_i$, and a connected finite etale Galois cover $V_i\to S_i$ [def-galois-object]. For a commutative ring $A$, work with module sheaves on the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. Locally constant means etale-locally constant [def-constructible-locally-constant]. Define $\mathcal W_{\mathcal P}(A)$ to consist of sheaves whose inverse-image restriction to every $S_i$ is a filtered colimit [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit] of sheaves admitting a finite filtration with locally constant successive quotients becoming constant [def-constructible-constant] on $V_i$. No finite-generation condition is imposed. Define $D^b_{\mathcal P}(X,A)$ to consist of bounded derived objects [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories] all of whose cohomology sheaves lie in $\mathcal W_{\mathcal P}(A)$. For a ground ring $\Lambda$, $\mathcal Q$ refines $\mathcal P$ if $\mathcal W_{\mathcal P}(\Lambda)\subseteq\mathcal W_{\mathcal Q}(\Lambda)$.
